<!-- ============ HERO ============ -->
<section class="hero" id="inicio">
  <canvas id="globe"></canvas>
  <svg class="winds" viewBox="0 0 1600 900" preserveAspectRatio="none" aria-hidden="true">
    <path d="M-100 220 C 300 160, 600 300, 1000 230 S 1500 160, 1750 240" stroke="rgba(127,227,224,.35)" stroke-width="1.2"/>
    <path d="M-100 420 C 260 380, 640 480, 980 420 S 1480 360, 1750 430" stroke="rgba(246,213,142,.35)" stroke-width="1.2" style="animation-delay:-3s"/>
    <path d="M-100 640 C 320 600, 600 700, 1020 630 S 1460 580, 1750 650" stroke="rgba(255,255,255,.25)" stroke-width="1" style="animation-delay:-6s"/>
    <path d="M-100 780 C 300 760, 700 830, 1100 770 S 1500 740, 1750 790" stroke="rgba(127,227,224,.22)" stroke-width="1" style="animation-delay:-1.5s"/>
  </svg>
  <div class="hero-inner">
    <div class="hero-copy">
      <div class="eyebrow" data-h><span class="pulse"></span>Agencia de marketing digital · Tenerife</div>
      <h1><span class="line"><span>El impulso</span></span><span class="line"><span>que tu negocio</span></span><span class="line"><span><em class="grad-text">necesita.</em></span></span></h1>
      <p class="lead" data-h style="transition-delay:.35s">Webs a medida, redes sociales y Google para negocios que quieren crecer. Como el alisio, empujamos tu marca hacia donde están tus clientes.</p>
      <div class="ctas" data-h style="transition-delay:.45s">
        <a href="#contacto" class="btn magnetic">Pide tu demo gratis <span class="arr"><svg width="14" height="14"><use href="#i-arrow"/></svg></span></a>
        <a href="#servicios" class="btn ghost hero-alt magnetic">Ver servicios <span class="arr"><svg width="14" height="14" style="transform:rotate(90deg)"><use href="#i-arrow"/></svg></span></a>
      </div>
      <div class="trust" data-h style="transition-delay:.55s">
        <span><svg><use href="#i-check"/></svg>Asesoría inicial gratis</span>
        <span><svg><use href="#i-check"/></svg>Demo de tu web sin compromiso</span>
        <span><svg><use href="#i-check"/></svg>Precios claros</span>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="hero-chip chip-a"><span class="ic"><svg><use href="#i-pin"/></svg></span><span><small>Base</small>Tenerife, Islas Canarias</span></div>
  <div class="hero-chip chip-b"><span class="ic"><svg><use href="#i-globe"/></svg></span><span><small>Alcance</small>Clientes en cualquier lugar</span></div>
  <div class="scroll-cue"><i></i>Desliza</div>
</section>

<section class="light sec" id="servicios">

A eso se suma el mantenimiento, que cuesta el 10% del precio de la web al mes y mantiene tu web siempre al día y funcionando.</p></div></details>
      <details class="fq"><summary><span class="fq-n">02</span><span class="fq-q">¿Puedo ver mi web antes de pagar?</span><span class="fq-pm"></span></summary><div class="fq-a"><p>Sí. Te preparamos una demo gratis con el diseño de tu web para que veas cómo quedaría. Si te convence, seguimos; si no, no pasa nada.</p></div></details>
      <details class="fq"><summary><span class="fq-n">03</span><span class="fq-q">¿Trabajáis solo con negocios de Canarias?</span><span class="fq-pm"></span></summary><div class="fq-a"><p>No. Nacimos en Tenerife, pero trabajamos en remoto con negocios de cualquier lugar. De Canarias para el mundo entero.</p></div></details>
      <details class="fq"><summary><span class="fq-n">04</span><span class="fq-q">¿La web y el dominio serán míos?</span><span class="fq-pm"></span></summary><div class="fq-a"><p>Sí. Tu dominio, tus textos y tus fotos son tuyos. Nosotros nos encargamos de que todo funcione.</p></div></details>
      <details class="fq"><summary><span class="fq-n">05</span><span class="fq-q">¿Qué diferencia hay entre los dos chatbots?</span><span class="fq-pm"></span></summary><div class="fq-a"><p>El chatbot de botones guía al cliente con opciones fijas (horarios, precios, reservas…). El chatbot con IA entiende cualquier pregunta escrita con sus propias palabras y responde de forma natural, a cualquier hora.</p></div></details>
      <details class="fq"><summary><span class="fq-n">06</span><span class="fq-q">¿Qué necesito para empezar?</span><span class="fq-pm"></span></summary><div class="fq-a"><p>Solo contarnos tu idea. Nosotros te guiamos con los textos, las fotos y todo lo técnico para que no tengas que preocuparte de nada.</p></div></details>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- ============ CONTACT ============ -->
<section class="contact sec" id="contacto">
  <div class="wrap contact-grid">
    <div>
      <span class="kicker" style="color:var(--sand)" data-reveal>Contacto</span>
      <h2 data-reveal>¿Hablamos<em class="grad-text">?</em></h2>
      <p class="lead" data-reveal>Cuéntanos qué necesitas y te respondemos con una propuesta. Si quieres, te preparamos una demo de tu web gratis.</p>
      <div class="c-links" data-reveal>
        <a href="#" id="lnkWa" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><span class="ic"><svg><use href="#i-wa"/></svg></span><span><b>WhatsApp</b><small>La forma más rápida de hablar con nosotros</small></span></a>
        <a href="https://www.instagram.com/alisio.digital/" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><span class="ic"><svg><use href="#i-ig"/></svg></span><span><b>@alisio.digital</b><small>Síguenos en Instagram</small></span></a>
        <a href="#" id="lnkMail"><span class="ic"><svg><use href="#i-mail"/></svg></span><span><b id="mailTxt">Email</b><small>Para propuestas y presupuestos</small></span></a>
      </div>
    </div>
    <form class="form" id="form" data-reveal style="--d:.1s" novalidate>
      <div class="two">
        <div class="field"><input id="fName" placeholder=" " required autocomplete="name"><label for="fName">Tu nombre</label></div>
        <div class="field"><input id="fBiz" placeholder=" " autocomplete="organization"><label for="fBiz">Tu negocio</label></div>
      </div>
      <div class="field"><input id="fPhone" placeholder=" " type="tel" autocomplete="tel"><label for="fPhone">Teléfono (opcional)</label></div>
      <div class="chips-l">¿Qué te interesa?</div>
      <div class="chips" id="chips">
        <button type="button">Web</button><button type="button">Instagram</button><button type="button">Google Business</button><button type="button">Chatbot</button><button type="button">Diseño o reels</button><button type="button">Publicidad</button><button type="button">Aún no lo sé</button>
      </div>
      <div class="field"><textarea id="fMsg" placeholder=" "></textarea><label for="fMsg">Cuéntanos un poco más</label></div>
      <button class="btn" type="submit">Enviar mensaje <span class="arr"><svg width="14" height="14"><use href="#i-arrow"/></svg></span></button>
      <p class="note">Te respondemos lo antes posible. Sin spam, prometido.</p>
    </form>
  </div>
</section>
</main>

  </div>
</footer>

const ISLANDS = [
  ['La Palma', -17.86, 28.68], ['El Hierro', -18.03, 27.74], ['La Gomera', -17.23, 28.10],
  ['Tenerife', -16.58, 28.27], ['Gran Canaria', -15.6, 27.96], ['Fuerteventura', -14.03, 28.38],
  ['Lanzarote', -13.63, 29.04]
];
const CITIES = [
  ['Madrid',-3.70,40.42],['Londres',-0.13,51.51],['París',2.35,48.86],['Berlín',13.40,52.52],
  ['Lisboa',-9.14,38.72],['Roma',12.5,41.9],['Nueva York',-74.0,40.71],['Miami',-80.19,25.76],
  ['Caracas',-66.90,10.49],['La Habana',-82.37,23.11],['Buenos Aires',-58.38,-34.60],['Ciudad de México',-99.13,19.43],
  ['São Paulo',-46.63,-23.55],['Dakar',-17.45,14.69],['Marrakech',-7.99,31.63],['Bogotá',-74.07,4.71],
  ['Los Ángeles',-118.24,34.05],['Vancouver',-123.12,49.28],['Toronto',-79.38,43.65],['Lima',-77.04,-12.05],['Santiago',-70.67,-33.45],
  ['Anchorage',-149.9,61.2],['Honolulu',-157.86,21.31],
  ['Ciudad del Cabo',18.42,-33.92],['Lagos',3.38,6.52],['Nairobi',36.82,-1.29],['El Cairo',31.24,30.04],
  ['Estambul',28.98,41.01],['Dubái',55.27,25.2],['Bombay',72.88,19.08],['Bangkok',100.5,13.76],['Singapur',103.82,1.35],
  ['Yakarta',106.85,-6.21],['Hong Kong',114.17,22.32],['Shanghái',121.47,31.23],['Seúl',126.98,37.57],['Tokio',139.69,35.68],
  ['Manila',120.98,14.6],['Sídney',151.21,-33.87],['Perth',115.86,-31.95],['Auckland',174.76,-36.85],['Estocolmo',18.07,59.33]
];
const ARCS = CITIES.map((c,i) => {
  const b=[c[1],c[2]], ip=d3.geoInterpolate(TF,b), dist=d3.geoDistance(TF,b);
  const n=Math.round(40+50*dist/Math.PI), hmax=.04+.2*(dist/Math.PI), pts=[];
  for(let k=0;k<=n;k++){ const t=k/n, p=ip(t); pts.push([p[0]*D2R, Math.cos(p[1]*D2R), Math.sin(p[1]*D2R), Math.sin(Math.PI*t)*hmax]); }
  return {name:c[0], pts, delay:i*0.026, cyc:(i*0.618)%1};
});

/* ---------------- GLOBE RENDERER ---------------- */
const cv = $('#globe'), ctx = cv.getContext('2d');
let W=0,H=0,DPR=1;
function resize(){
  DPR = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio||1, 1.5);
  const host = $('#inicio');
  W = host.clientWidth; H = host.clientHeight;
  cv.width = Math.round(W*DPR); cv.height = Math.round(H*DPR);
  ctx.setTransform(DPR,0,0,DPR,0,0);
}
resize();

const proj = d3.geoOrthographic().clipAngle(90).precision(.35);
const path = d3.geoPath(proj, ctx);

// state
const S = {lon:-16, lat:28.3, R:1000, cx:0, cy:0, land:1, reg:1, world:0, dots:0, grat2:.5, grat10:0, atmo:0, stars:0,
  labels:0, tfPulse:0, arcsP:0, arcsMode:'grow', arcsA:1, cometA:0, canGlow:1, time:0, alpha:1};

function rot(lon0, lat0){
  const l0=lon0*D2R, p0=lat0*D2R; return {l0, cp:Math.cos(p0), sp:Math.sin(p0)};
}
function P(rt, lam, cphi, sphi){ // returns [x,y,z] unit
  const dl = lam - rt.l0, cdl = Math.cos(dl);
  return [cphi*Math.sin(dl), rt.cp*sphi - rt.sp*cphi*cdl, rt.sp*sphi + rt.cp*cphi*cdl];
}

function draw(){
  const {R,cx,cy} = S;
  ctx.clearRect(0,0,W,H);
  ctx.globalAlpha = S.alpha;
  const minWH = Math.min(W,H);
  const globeVisible = R < Math.hypot(W,H);

  // stars
  if (S.stars > .01){
    for (const s of STARS){
      const x = ((s.x*W*1.2 + S.lon*1.4) % (W*1.2) + W*1.2) % (W*1.2) - W*.1, y = s.y*H;
      const dx=x-cx, dy=y-cy; if (dx*dx+dy*dy < R*R*1.02) continue;
      ctx.globalAlpha = S.alpha*S.stars*s.a*(.65+.35*Math.sin(S.time*1.6+s.tw));
      ctx.fillStyle='#fff'; ctx.fillRect(x,y,s.r,s.r);
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = S.alpha;
  }

  // atmosphere glow
  if (globeVisible && S.atmo > .01){
    const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx,cy,R*.92,cx,cy,R*1.32);
    g.addColorStop(0,`rgba(46,196,198,${.38*S.atmo})`);
    g.addColorStop(.25,`rgba(24,150,160,${.16*S.atmo})`);
    g.addColorStop(1,'rgba(24,150,160,0)');
    ctx.fillStyle=g; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx,cy,R*1.32,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
  }

  proj.rotate([-S.lon,-S.lat]).scale(R).translate([cx,cy]);

  // ocean sphere
  ctx.save();
  ctx.beginPath(); path(SPHERE);
  const og = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx-R*.35,cy-R*.4,R*.05,cx,cy,R*1.02);
  og.addColorStop(0,'#145A80'); og.addColorStop(.45,'#0A3352'); og.addColorStop(1,'#041A2C');
  ctx.fillStyle = R > minWH*3 ? '#0A2F4C' : og;
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.clip();

  // graticules
  if (S.grat2 > .01){ ctx.beginPath(); path(GRAT2); ctx.strokeStyle=`rgba(127,227,224,${.08*S.grat2})`; ctx.lineWidth=1; ctx.stroke(); }
  if (S.grat10 > .01){ ctx.beginPath(); path(GRAT10); ctx.strokeStyle=`rgba(127,227,224,${.07*S.grat10})`; ctx.lineWidth=.8; ctx.stroke(); }

  // world (coarse)
  if (S.world > .01){
    ctx.beginPath(); path(WORLD);
    ctx.fillStyle=`rgba(46,196,198,${.10*S.world})`; ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle=`rgba(127,227,224,${.35*S.world})`; ctx.lineWidth=.7; ctx.stroke();
  }
  // regional (fine)
  if (S.reg > .01){
    ctx.beginPath(); path(REG);
    ctx.fillStyle=`rgba(17,72,106,${.95*S.reg})`; ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle=`rgba(127,227,224,${.45*S.reg})`; ctx.lineWidth=1.1; ctx.stroke();
  }
  // dots
  if (S.dots > .01){
    const rt = rot(S.lon,S.lat);
    const sz = clamp(R*.0062, .7, 2.4);
    const buckets = [[],[],[],[]];
    for (let i=0;i<DN;i++){
      const dl = DL[i]-rt.l0, cdl=Math.cos(dl);
      const z = rt.sp*DS[i] + rt.cp*DC[i]*cdl; if (z <= 0.02) continue;
      const x = cx + R*DC[i]*Math.sin(dl), y = cy - R*(rt.cp*DS[i] - rt.sp*DC[i]*cdl);
      if (x<-4||y<-4||x>W+4||y>H+4) continue;
      buckets[z>.75?3:z>.5?2:z>.25?1:0].push(x,y);
    }
    const al=[.25,.45,.7,.95];
    for (let b=0;b<4;b++){
      const arr=buckets[b]; ctx.fillStyle=`rgba(173,240,236,${al[b]*S.dots})`;
      for (let k=0;k<arr.length;k+=2) ctx.fillRect(arr[k]-sz/2,arr[k+1]-sz/2,sz,sz);
    }
  }
  // canaries
  if (S.land > .01){
    ctx.beginPath(); path(CAN);
    if (S.canGlow > .01 && R > 1500){ ctx.shadowColor='rgba(246,213,142,.55)'; ctx.shadowBlur=24*S.canGlow; }
    const lg = ctx.createLinearGradient(0,cy-R*.06,0,cy+R*.06);
    lg.addColorStop(0,'#F9E2AE'); lg.addColorStop(1,'#E9B95A');
    ctx.fillStyle = R > 2500 ? lg : '#F6D58E'; ctx.globalAlpha=S.alpha*S.land; ctx.fill();
    ctx.shadowBlur=0; ctx.globalAlpha=S.alpha;
    if (R > 1500){ ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(255,255,255,.55)'; ctx.lineWidth=1; ctx.stroke(); }
  }
  ctx.restore();

  // limb light / terminator
  if (globeVisible && R < minWH*3){
    const sh = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx+R*.25,cy+R*.3,R*.2,cx,cy,R);
    sh.addColorStop(0,'rgba(2,8,14,0)'); sh.addColorStop(.75,'rgba(2,8,14,.08)'); sh.addColorStop(1,'rgba(2,8,14,.55)');
    ctx.fillStyle=sh; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx,cy,R,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle=`rgba(127,227,224,${.35*S.atmo})`; ctx.lineWidth=1.2; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx,cy,R,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.stroke();
  }

  // arcs
  const rt = rot(S.lon,S.lat);
  const tfp = P(rt, TF[0]*D2R, Math.cos(TF[1]*D2R), Math.sin(TF[1]*D2R));
  if (S.arcsA > .01 || S.cometA > .01) drawArcs(rt);

  // Tenerife pulse
  if (S.tfPulse > .01 && tfp[2] > 0){
    const x = cx + R*tfp[0], y = cy - R*tfp[1];
    const ph = (S.time*.8)%1;
    ctx.strokeStyle=`rgba(246,213,142,${(1-ph)*.9*S.tfPulse})`; ctx.lineWidth=1.5;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x,y,4+ph*22,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.fillStyle=`rgba(246,213,142,${S.tfPulse})`; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x,y,3.4,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle=`rgba(255,255,255,${S.tfPulse})`; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x,y,1.5,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
  }

  // island labels
  if (S.labels > .01){
    ctx.font = `500 ${clamp(W/90,10,13)}px "Inter Display", Inter, sans-serif`;
    try { ctx.letterSpacing = W<600 ? '1.5px' : '3px'; } catch(e){}
    ctx.textAlign='center';
    ISLANDS.forEach((isl,i) => {
      const a = S.labels * clamp((S.labelsT - i*.09)/.35, 0, 1);
      if (a <= 0) return;
      const pt = proj([isl[1], isl[2]]); if (!pt) return;
      const off = clamp(R*.0042, 14, 60);
      const up = (i%2===0) ? -1 : 1;
      const ly = pt[1] + up*off;
      ctx.strokeStyle=`rgba(255,255,255,${.35*a})`; ctx.lineWidth=1;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(pt[0], pt[1] + up*5); ctx.lineTo(pt[0], ly - up*(up<0?12:-2)); ctx.stroke();
      ctx.fillStyle=`rgba(255,255,255,${.9*a})`;
      ctx.fillText(isl[0].toUpperCase(), pt[0], up<0 ? ly-16 : ly+14);
    });
    try { ctx.letterSpacing = '0px'; } catch(e){}
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

function arcXY(rt, p){
  const v = P(rt, p[0], p[1], p[2]); const k = 1+p[3];
  const vis = v[2] > 0 || (k*k*(v[0]*v[0]+v[1]*v[1]) > 1);
  return [S.cx + S.R*k*v[0], S.cy - S.R*k*v[1], vis];
}
function strokeArc(rt, pts, t0, t1, alpha, width){
  const n = pts.length-1, i0 = Math.floor(t0*n), i1 = Math.ceil(t1*n);
  if (i1 <= i0) return null;
  ctx.beginPath(); let started=false, last=null;
  for (let i=i0;i<=i1;i++){
    const q = arcXY(rt, pts[i]);
    if (!q[2]) { started=false; continue; }
    if (!started){ ctx.moveTo(q[0],q[1]); started=true; } else ctx.lineTo(q[0],q[1]);
    last=q;
  }
  ctx.strokeStyle=`rgba(246,213,142,${alpha})`; ctx.lineWidth=width; ctx.stroke();
  return last;
}
function drawArcs(rt){
  ctx.lineCap='round';
  const w = clamp(S.R*.004,1,2);
  ARCS.forEach((a) => {
    // grow mode (intro)
    if (S.arcsA > .01){
      const p = easeOut(clamp((S.arcsP - a.delay)/.45, 0, 1));
      if (p > 0){
        const head = strokeArc(rt, a.pts, 0, p, .75*S.arcsA, w);
        if (head){
          ctx.fillStyle=`rgba(255,255,255,${S.arcsA})`; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(head[0],head[1], p>=1?2.2:2.6, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
          if (p>=1){ ctx.strokeStyle=`rgba(246,213,142,${.5*S.arcsA})`; ctx.lineWidth=1; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(head[0],head[1],5+3*Math.sin(S.time*3+a.delay*20),0,Math.PI*2); ctx.stroke(); }
        }
      }
    }
    // comet mode (hero loop)
    if (S.cometA > .01){
      const c = ((S.time*.12) + a.cyc) % 1;
      const head = clamp(c*1.7, 0, 1), tail = clamp((c-.28)*1.7, 0, 1);
      if (head > tail){
        const fade = 1 - clamp((c-.6)/.4,0,1);
        const h = strokeArc(rt, a.pts, tail, head, .7*S.cometA*fade, w);
        if (h && head < 1){ ctx.fillStyle=`rgba(255,255,255,${S.cometA*fade})`; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(h[0],h[1],2.2,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill(); }
        if (h && head >= 1){ ctx.fillStyle=`rgba(246,213,142,${.8*S.cometA*fade})`; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(h[0],h[1],2,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill(); }
      }
    }
  });
}

/* ---------------- INTRO TIMELINE ---------------- */
const intro = $('#intro');
const T = {zoomA:1100, zoomB:4300, arcs:3500, text:4400, out:7300, end:8800};
function VH(){ return Math.min(H, innerHeight); }
function closeScale(){
  const p = W/VH() < .8, span = p ? 4.6 : 5.6; // degrees across
  return (W*(p?.98:.82)) / (span*D2R);
}
function farR(){ return Math.min(W,VH()) * (W/VH() < .8 ? .40 : .36); }
function heroTarget(){
  const host = $('#inicio');
  const w = host.clientWidth, h = host.clientHeight;
  if (w < 900){ const R=Math.min(w*.72, 420); return {cx:w*.5, cy:h - R*.5, R}; }
  return {cx: w*.72, cy: h*.54, R: Math.min(h*.40, w*.27)};
}

let t0 = null, phase = 'intro', skipAt = null, outStart = null, fromOut = null, heroStart = null;
const hudBar = $('#hudBar'), hudAlt = $('#hudAlt'), hudCoord = $('#hudCoord');
const words = $$('#tagLine .w');
let textShown=false, hudOn=false;

function introStep(now){
  const t = now - t0;
  S.time = now/1000;
  const S0 = closeScale(), S1 = farR();
  // zoom
  const z = easeIO(seg(t, T.zoomA, T.zoomB));
  const drift = 1 + .05*easeOut(seg(t,0,T.zoomA));
  S.R = Math.exp(lerp(Math.log(S0*drift), Math.log(S1), z));
  S.cx = W/2; S.cy = VH()/2 - (W/VH()<.8 ? VH()*.02 : 0);
  S.lon = lerp(-15.85, -24, easeIO(seg(t, T.zoomA+400, T.zoomB+600))) - Math.max(0, t - T.zoomB)*0.0016;
  S.lat = lerp(28.35, 22, easeIO(seg(t, T.zoomA+400, T.zoomB+600)));
  // layers
  const k = S1 / S.R; // 0..1 (1 = far)
  S.alpha = easeOut(seg(t, 0, 900)) * (1 - .5*seg(t, T.text, T.text+900));
  S.labels = 1 - seg(t, T.zoomA+200, T.zoomA+1000);
  S.labelsT = seg(t, 200, 1200) * 1.6;
  S.reg = 1 - seg(S1/S.R, .06, .22);
  S.world = seg(S1/S.R, .05, .3);
  S.dots = seg(S1/S.R, .12, .6);
  S.grat2 = (1 - seg(S1/S.R, .03, .12)) * S.alpha;
  S.grat10 = seg(S1/S.R, .1, .5);
  S.atmo = seg(S1/S.R, .25, .9);
  S.stars = seg(S1/S.R, .2, .8);
  S.canGlow = 1;
  S.tfPulse = seg(t, 600, 1200);
  S.arcsP = clamp((t - T.arcs)/1400, 0, 1.6);
  S.arcsA = 1; S.cometA = 0;
  // HUD
  if (!hudOn && t > 500){ hudOn=true; $('#hudTL').classList.add('on'); $('#hudBR').classList.add('on'); }
  const altKm = Math.round(lerp(420, 36000, Math.pow(seg(t, T.zoomA, T.zoomB), 2.2)));
  hudAlt.textContent = 'Altitud · ' + altKm.toLocaleString('es-ES') + ' km';
  hudBar.style.setProperty('--p', seg(t, 0, T.out).toFixed(3));
  if (t > T.zoomB){ $('#hudTL').classList.remove('on'); $('#hudBR').classList.remove('on'); }
  // tagline
  if (!textShown && t > T.text){
    textShown=true;
    words.forEach((w,i) => w.style.setProperty('--wd', (0.25 + i*0.16) + 's'));
    requestAnimationFrame(() => intro.classList.add('t-on'));
    setTimeout(() => intro.classList.add('t-sub'), 1300);
  }
  if (t > T.out) startOut(now);
}

function startOut(now){
  if (phase !== 'intro') return;
  phase = 'out'; outStart = now;
  document.body.classList.add('intro-out');
  fromOut = {alpha:S.alpha, R:S.R, cx:S.cx, cy:S.cy, lon:S.lon, lat:S.lat, arcsA:S.arcsA, stars:S.stars, dots:S.dots, world:S.world, atmo:S.atmo, reg:S.reg, grat10:S.grat10};
  intro.classList.add('t-out');
  setTimeout(() => { intro.classList.add('fade'); $('#introBg').classList.add('fade'); }, 250);
  setTimeout(() => { $('#inicio').classList.add('ready'); $('#nav').style.transform='none'; }, 650);
}

function outStep(now){
  const t = now - outStart, D = skipAt ? 1100 : 1500;
  S.time = now/1000;
  const p = easeIO(clamp((t - 150)/D, 0, 1));
  // compute hero target in viewport coords (hero is at top, scroll locked)
  const tg = heroTarget();
  S.R = lerp(fromOut.R, tg.R, p);
  S.cx = lerp(fromOut.cx, tg.cx, p);
  S.cy = lerp(fromOut.cy, tg.cy, p);
  S.lon = fromOut.lon - t*0.0016;
  S.lat = lerp(fromOut.lat, 22, p);
  S.reg = fromOut.reg*(1-p); S.world = lerp(fromOut.world,1,p); S.dots = lerp(fromOut.dots,1,p);
  S.atmo = lerp(fromOut.atmo,1,p); S.grat10=lerp(fromOut.grat10,1,p); S.grat2=0; S.labels=0;
  S.stars = lerp(fromOut.stars, .55, p);
  S.alpha = lerp(fromOut.alpha,1,p); S.tfPulse = 1;
  S.arcsP = Math.max(S.arcsP, 1.6);
  S.arcsA = fromOut.arcsA*(1-p); S.cometA = p;
  if (t > D + 400) finishIntro(now);
}

function finishIntro(now){
  phase = 'hero'; heroStart = now;
  intro.classList.add('done'); intro.style.display='none'; $('#introBg').style.display='none';
  cv.classList.add('hero-mode');
  document.body.classList.remove('lock','intro-out');
  const tg = heroTarget(); Object.assign(S, tg);
  S.heroLon0 = S.lon; S.heroT0 = now;
}

function heroStep(now){
  S.time = now/1000;
  const tg = heroTarget(); S.R = tg.R; S.cx = tg.cx; S.cy = tg.cy;
  S.lon = S.heroLon0 - (now - S.heroT0)*0.0016*(RM?0:1);
  S.lat = 22;
  S.reg=0; S.world=1; S.dots=1; S.atmo=1; S.grat10=1; S.grat2=0; S.labels=0; S.stars=.55; S.tfPulse=1; S.arcsA=0; S.cometA=RM?0:1; S.alpha=1; S.land=1;
}

let heroVisible = true;
new IntersectionObserver(e => { heroVisible = e[0].isIntersecting; }, {threshold:0}).observe($('#inicio'));

function loop(now){
  if (t0 === null) t0 = now;
  if (phase === 'intro') introStep(now);
  else if (phase === 'out') outStep(now);
  else heroStep(now);
  if (phase !== 'hero' || (heroVisible && !document.hidden)) draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}

$('#skip').addEventListener('click', () => {
  skipAt = performance.now();
  if (!textShown){ textShown = true; }
  startOut(performance.now());
});
addEventListener('keydown', e => { if (phase==='intro' && (e.key==='Escape' || e.key===' ' || e.key==='Enter')) $('#skip').click(); });
addEventListener('resize', () => { resize(); });

$('#nav').style.transform = 'translateY(-110%)';
if (RM){
  // movimiento reducido: sin intro
  intro.style.display='none'; $('#introBg').style.display='none'; phase='hero'; cv.classList.add('hero-mode'); resize();
  document.body.classList.remove('lock'); $('#inicio').classList.add('ready'); $('#nav').style.transform='none';
  Object.assign(S, heroTarget()); S.lon=-24; S.heroLon0=-24; S.heroT0=performance.now();
}
const startGlobe = () => requestAnimationFrame(loop);
if (document.fonts && document.fonts.ready) Promise.race([document.fonts.ready, new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,800))]).then(startGlobe); else startGlobe();

/* ---------------- SITE INTERACTIONS ---------------- */
// nav
const nav = $('#nav'), prog = $('#progress');
const lightSecs = $$('.light');
function onScroll(){
  const y = scrollY;
  nav.classList.toggle('scrolled', y > 40);
  const mid = 40;
  const onLight = lightSecs.some(s => { const r = s.getBoundingClientRect(); return r.top <= mid && r.bottom >= mid; });
  nav.classList.toggle('on-light', onLight);
  const max = document.documentElement.scrollHeight - innerHeight;
  prog.style.transform = `scaleX(${max>0 ? y/max : 0})`;
  mani(); stepsP();
}
addEventListener('scroll', onScroll, {passive:true});

// mobile menu
$('#burger').addEventListener('click', () => { const o = document.body.classList.toggle('menu-open'); $('#burger').setAttribute('aria-label', o ? 'Cerrar menú' : 'Abrir menú'); });
$$('#mmenu a').forEach(a => a.addEventListener('click', () => document.body.classList.remove('menu-open')));

// reveal
const io = new IntersectionObserver(es => es.forEach(e => { if (e.isIntersecting){ e.target.classList.add('in'); io.unobserve(e.target); } }), {threshold:.12, rootMargin:'0px 0px -6% 0px'});
$$('[data-reveal]').forEach(el => io.observe(el));

// counters
const cio = new IntersectionObserver(es => es.forEach(e => {
  if (!e.isIntersecting) return; cio.unobserve(e.target);
  const el = e.target, to = +el.dataset.count, st = performance.now(), d = 1600;
  if (to === 0){ el.textContent='0'; return; }
  const tick = n => { const p = easeOutExpo(clamp((n-st)/d,0,1)); el.textContent = Math.round(to*p); if (p<1) requestAnimationFrame(tick); };
  requestAnimationFrame(tick);
}), {threshold:.6});
$$('[data-count]').forEach(el => cio.observe(el));

// manifesto words
const maniEl = $('#mani');
const accWords = ['alisio','Canarias','mundo.','clientes.','impulsamos'];
maniEl.innerHTML = maniEl.textContent.split(' ').map(w => `<span class="wd${accWords.includes(w)?' acc':''}">${w}</span>`).join(' ');
const maniW = $$('.wd', maniEl);
function mani(){
  const r = maniEl.getBoundingClientRect();
  const p = clamp((innerHeight*.85 - r.top) / (r.height + innerHeight*.35), 0, 1);
  const n = Math.round(p*maniW.length*1.05);
  maniW.forEach((w,i) => w.classList.toggle('on', i < n));
}

// steps line
const stepsEl = $('#steps'), stepLine = $('#stepLine'), stepEls = $$('.step');
function stepsP(){
  const r = stepsEl.getBoundingClientRect();
  const p = clamp((innerHeight*.75 - r.top) / (innerHeight*.5), 0, 1);
  stepLine.style.setProperty('--p', p.toFixed(3));
  stepEls.forEach((s,i) => s.classList.toggle('on', p >= i/(stepEls.length-1) - .02));
}
onScroll();

// ig grid
const igCols = ['#0B3454','#1896A0','#F6D58E','#2EC4C6','#04121F','#E9B95A','#0F4569','#7FE3E0','#F6F2EA','#1896A0','#0B3454','#F6D58E'];
$('#igGrid').innerHTML = igCols.map((c,i) => `<i style="--i:${i};background:${i%4===1?`linear-gradient(135deg,${c},#04121F)`:c}"></i>`).join('');

// spotlight cards
$$('.card').forEach(c => c.addEventListener('pointermove', e => {
  const r = c.getBoundingClientRect(); c.style.setProperty('--mx', (e.clientX-r.left)+'px'); c.style.setProperty('--my', (e.clientY-r.top)+'px');
}));

// magnetic
if (matchMedia('(pointer:fine)').matches){
  $$('.magnetic').forEach(b => {
    b.addEventListener('pointermove', e => { const r=b.getBoundingClientRect(); b.style.transform=`translate(${(e.clientX-r.left-r.width/2)*.18}px,${(e.clientY-r.top-r.height/2)*.28}px)`; });
    b.addEventListener('pointerleave', () => b.style.transform='');
  });
  // cursor
  const cd = $('#curD'), cr = $('#curR'); let mx=-100,my=-100,rx=-100,ry=-100;
  addEventListener('pointermove', e => { mx=e.clientX; my=e.clientY; cd.style.transform=`translate(${mx}px,${my}px)`; });
  (function cl(){ rx+=(mx-rx)*.16; ry+=(my-ry)*.16; cr.style.transform=`translate(${rx}px,${ry}px)`; requestAnimationFrame(cl); })();
  document.addEventListener('pointerover', e => { cr.classList.toggle('big', !!e.target.closest('.wk-media')); });
}

// trabajos: recorrido de la web al pasar el ratón
$$('.wk2').forEach(card => {
  const media = $('.wk-media', card), img = $('.wk-shot img', card);
  const setDist = () => { const d = img.offsetHeight - media.offsetHeight; card.style.setProperty('--dist', -Math.max(0,d) + 'px'); card.style.setProperty('--dur', Math.max(6, d/110).toFixed(1) + 's'); };
  const on = () => { setDist(); card.classList.add('play'); };
  const off = () => card.classList.remove('play');
  if (matchMedia('(hover:hover)').matches){ media.addEventListener('mouseenter', on); media.addEventListener('mouseleave', off); }
  else { new IntersectionObserver(es => es.forEach(e => e.isIntersecting ? on() : off()), {threshold:.6}).observe(media); }
  if (img.complete) setDist(); else img.addEventListener('load', setDist);
  addEventListener('resize', setDist);
});
// cintas curvas con texto en movimiento
(function ribbons(){
  const unitTxt = 'Diseño web   ✦   Instagram   ✦   Google Business   ✦   SEO local   ✦   Publicidad   ✦   Branding   ✦   ';
  const unitTxtB = 'Webs que venden   ·   Redes que enamoran   ·   Google que te encuentra   ·   De Canarias para el mundo   ·   ';
  const setup = (tp, meas, txt, pathId) => {
    meas.textContent = txt; const unit = meas.getComputedTextLength();
    const L = document.getElementById(pathId).getTotalLength();
    tp.textContent = txt.repeat(Math.ceil((L + unit*2) / unit) + 1);
    return unit;
  };
  let uA = 0, uB = 0, vis = true, t0 = performance.now();
  const tA = $('#rtA'), tB = $('#rtB');
  const go = () => { uA = setup(tA, $('#rtMeasA'), unitTxt, 'rpA'); uB = setup(tB, $('#rtMeasB'), unitTxtB, 'rpB'); };
  (document.fonts && document.fonts.ready ? document.fonts.ready : Promise.resolve()).then(go);
  new IntersectionObserver(e => { vis = e[0].isIntersecting; }).observe($('.ribbons'));
  (function tick(now){
    if (vis && uA && !RM){
      const t = (now - t0)/1000;
      tA.setAttribute('startOffset', (-(t*70 % uA)).toFixed(1));
      tB.setAttribute('startOffset', (-uB + (t*55 % uB)).toFixed(1));
    }
    requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  })(t0);
})();
// FAQ: only one open
$$('.fq').forEach(d => d.addEventListener('toggle', () => { if (d.open) $$('.fq').forEach(o => { if (o!==d) o.open=false; }); }));

// contact config
const waBase = CONFIG.whatsapp ? `https://wa.me/${CONFIG.whatsapp}` : `https://www.instagram.com/${CONFIG.instagram}/`;
$('#lnkWa').href = CONFIG.whatsapp ? waBase + '?text=' + encodeURIComponent('¡Hola Alisio Digital! Me gustaría información.') : waBase;
$$('.js-wa').forEach(a => { a.href = $('#lnkWa').href; a.target='_blank'; a.rel='noopener'; });
if (CONFIG.email){ $('#lnkMail').href = 'mailto:'+CONFIG.email; $('#mailTxt').textContent = CONFIG.email; }
else { $('#lnkMail').style.display='none'; }

// chips
$$('#chips button').forEach(b => b.addEventListener('click', () => b.classList.toggle('on')));
// plan buttons preselect
$$('[data-plan]').forEach(a => a.addEventListener('click', () => {
  const map = {'Web':'Web','Redes':'Instagram','Diseño':'Diseño o reels'};
  const want = map[a.dataset.plan] || 'Web';
  $$('#chips button').forEach(b => { if (b.textContent === want) b.classList.add('on'); });
  const m = $('#fMsg'); const card = a.closest('.plan,.pc,.extras'); const t = card && card.querySelector('h3,.pc-tag'); const nm = a.dataset.name || (t && t.textContent.trim()); if (!m.value && nm) m.value = `Me interesa: ${nm}.`;
}));

function toast(msg){ const t=$('#toast'); t.textContent=msg; t.classList.add('show'); clearTimeout(toast._t); toast._t=setTimeout(()=>t.classList.remove('show'),3800); }
$('#form').addEventListener('submit', e => {
  e.preventDefault();
  const name = $('#fName').value.trim();
  if (!name){ $('#fName').focus(); toast('Escribe tu nombre para continuar 🙂'); return; }
  const biz = $('#fBiz').value.trim(), phone = $('#fPhone').value.trim(), msg = $('#fMsg').value.trim();
  const ints = $$('#chips button.on').map(b => b.textContent);
  const text = [`¡Hola Alisio Digital! Soy ${name}${biz?` de ${biz}`:''}.`, ints.length?`Me interesa: ${ints.join(', ')}.`:'', msg, phone?`Mi teléfono: ${phone}`:''].filter(Boolean).join('\n');
  if (CONFIG.whatsapp){ window.open(`https://wa.me/${CONFIG.whatsapp}?text=${encodeURIComponent(text)}`, '_blank'); toast('Abriendo WhatsApp con tu mensaje…'); }
  else if (CONFIG.email){ location.href = `mailto:${CONFIG.email}?subject=${encodeURIComponent('Contacto web · '+name)}&body=${encodeURIComponent(text)}`; toast('Abriendo tu correo…'); }
  else { try { navigator.clipboard.writeText(text); } catch(_){} window.open(`https://ig.me/m/${CONFIG.instagram}`, '_blank'); toast('Mensaje copiado. Pégalo en nuestro chat de Instagram.'); }
});

// toggle redes
let netMode = 1;
const nt = $('.net-toggle');
$$('.net-toggle button').forEach(btn => btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
  const n = +btn.dataset.net; if (n === netMode) return; netMode = n;
  $$('.net-toggle button').forEach(x => { const on = x===btn; x.classList.toggle('on', on); x.setAttribute('aria-selected', on); });
  nt.classList.toggle('two', n===2);
  $$('#tarifas-redes [data-p1]').forEach((el,i) => { el.classList.add('swap'); setTimeout(() => { el.textContent = el.dataset['p'+n]; el.classList.remove('swap'); }, 220 + i*60); });
}));
// jump pills
const pj = $$('.pjump a');
const pio = new IntersectionObserver(es => es.forEach(e => { if (e.isIntersecting) pj.forEach(a => a.classList.toggle('on', a.getAttribute('href') === '#'+e.target.id)); }), {rootMargin:'-45% 0px -50% 0px'});
$$('.pblock').forEach(b => pio.observe(b));

})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
